description: Every hook runs the boards binary, through boards/boards.sh or a fleet shim that calls it. The board's hooks are `boards hook <event>` (boards/src/hooks/): SessionStart clears the checkout's focus on every start but a compaction, reminds the session to check the board first and reconcile it before stopping, and catches up on release tags; PreToolUse on the Agent tool binds each spawn to its card when it is sent, the card its Board-Item: line names or else the focus at that moment, and starts work on it; SubagentStart notes the start, and a resume starts work again; SubagentStop, matched to the fleet agents but the lead, enforces the handoff format, binds the agent to the card its spawn was sent for, turns Blocker: lines into Actions for Human and runs the card gate on a coder's or scripter's stop; TaskCompleted runs the card gate on a [board:<id>] task; PostToolUse on Bash starts the test gate for a pushed release tag whose Cards: line names cards, which moves them from Done to Released; and Stop sends the lead back once when its focused card has unticked criteria, unless the board's config sets sendBackAtStop: false. boards-binary.sh fetches the release build of the binary for this plugin version at SessionStart. The fleet's hooks are shims onto `boards fleet <tool>`: enforce-agent-scope.sh holds each agent to its tool boundaries and fails closed, agent-clock.sh caps a break-mode reviewer's wall clock, enforce-disabled-agents.sh denies a spawn of an agent the project disables and fails closed, and main-fast-forward.sh brings the main checkout's base branch level with its remote. Until CF-1.5 removes the old board and the state branch, board-binary.sh still fetches the old board's binary for its MCP server, and memory-state.sh still carries agent memory to coder-fleet/state.
